description: VN→ZH possessive marker drop: Vietnamese 'sách của tôi' (book of-me) maps to 我的书, but learners drop 的 ('这是我书'). Rule zh-possessive-de-insert inserts 的 in the unambiguous predicative frame 是 + pronoun + a closed possession noun.
fp_risk_note: Low risk. Inserts 的 only in the frame 是 + pronoun + a closed possession noun (书/车/手机/电脑/房子/衣服/钱包/雨伞). A dative 'give me a book' ('给我书', no 是), the kinship/我家 cases (家 not in the set, where 的 is naturally dropped), and an already-correct '这是我的书' all abstain.

positive.notes: 是我书 → 是我的书 (insert possessive 的).
是他手机 → 是他的手机.

negative.notes: Dative 'give me a book' (no 是) — 我 is the recipient, not a possessor, must abstain.
家 (home) naturally drops 的 ('this is my home') and is not in the noun set, must abstain.
